At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Ripple is the leader in enterprise blockchain and crypto solutions, redefining how the world moves, manages, tokenizes and stores value. A company with more than 900 global employees and 15 offices. An opportunity to join a team empowered to deliver on its mission to build crypto solutions for a world without economic borders. To date, Ripple Payments has processed 27M lifetime transactions worth nearly $50B. A vision that has the potential to impact directly on how value moves around the world.

Reporting to the senior manager, global liquidity management, this person will be responsible for assisting with all aspects of global treasury liquidity management. This individual will collaborate daily with cross-functional/cross-regional members

WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Global Liquidity Leadership

  • Run daily global liquidity positioning: Lead the daily process of positioning cash and crypto assets across all regions and entities so we meet global obligations and fund products on time.
  • Forecast liquidity needs globally: Build and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly forecasts for every subsidiary and business owner, with local-currency and USD views, so funding is in place when needed.
  • Optimize pooling and yield: Lead global cash and stablecoin pooling to minimize idle balances, improve yield, and design efficient funding structures across entities, currencies, and time zones.
  • Design global liquidity structures: Shape and execute netting, in-house bank, and follow-the-sun liquidity models that work across jurisdictions, adapting them to local legal, tax, and regulatory limits.
  • Own cash reporting: Deliver periodic global cash reports and forecasts that give management clear visibility into balances and sources and uses of cash.
  • Improve working capital: Partner with Finance to define, report on, and drive improvement in working capital metrics.
  • Build treasury systems: Work with treasury leadership to shape and execute our global treasury management system strategy across business lines, and develop the tools that support day-to-day liquidity management, including bank connectivity and data capture.
  • Manage FX risk: Monitor and build infrastructure to mitigate exposure from foreign-currency assets and liabilities globally, including emerging market currencies where hedging is limited or costly.
  • Manage banking relationships: Own relationships with global and regional banking partners, including local FX and settlement providers, to implement liquidity and investment strategies.
  • Partner across the business: Build strong working relationships with Accounting, Finance Ops, Tax, Compliance, Crypto Ops, and other teams, and guide decisions on how cash and cash equivalents are used.

LatAm and Regulatory Focus

  • Lead LatAm liquidity strategy: Serve as the treasury owner for Brazil and the broader region, accounting for local banking infrastructure, settlement cycles, capital controls, and currency convertibility constraints, and integrate these into the global liquidity plan.
  • Navigate local regulatory requirements: Partner with Tax, Legal, and Compliance to ensure liquidity movements comply with Brazilian and regional FX and capital flow rules, including central bank registrations and declarations for cross-border flows, intercompany loans, capital injections, and dividends.
  • Coordinate regulatory reporting data: Make sure treasury data supports local regulatory and central bank filings, and clarify internal ownership of each.
  • Stay ahead of regulatory change: Monitor developments in Brazilian and regional regulation, including virtual asset and stablecoin frameworks, and translate them into treasury process and policy updates.

Team

  • Develop others: Mentor new hires and junior team members, and help build regional treasury capability.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

Global Treasury

  • 8+ years of Treasury experience at a multinational corporation, financial institution, remittance company, or crypto company
  • Track record leading daily cash management and cash forecasting across global entities
  • Experience designing and implementing netting, a global in-house bank, or follow-the-sun liquidity structures
  • Hands-on experience with bank data integration and analysis
  • Experience managing FX exposure across multiple currencies, including emerging markets
  • Success building reporting, accountability, and performance mechanisms that help a team operate at a high level

LatAm and Regulatory Expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Brazilian FX and capital flow regulation, including BCB reporting and registration requirements for cross-border transactions
  • Working knowledge of Brazilian tax considerations for treasury, such as IOF, withholding taxes, and transfer pricing on intercompany funding
  • Experience managing liquidity across multiple LatAm jurisdictions, with an understanding of capital controls and convertibility constraints

General

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to run multiple projects at once
  • Ability to partner with and influence a globally distributed team across time zones
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus
  • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and the ability to influence teams whose priorities compete
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills; experience with other analytical tools is a plus
  • A collaborative approach that promotes excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement through technology
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or a related business field

Nice to Have

  • MBA/CTP/CFA/FRM
  • Familiarity with Brazil’s virtual asset and stablecoin regulatory framework
  • Experience coordinating with local counsel, tax advisors, and external auditors on regulatory matters

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Team

The Solutions Architecture team partners with Stripe’s users to design and build transformative solutions that unlock growth, modernize business models, and shape the future of commerce. We work with executives, product leaders, and engineering teams at the world’s largest and most innovative companies, helping them translate ambitious strategies into scalable solutions on Stripe.

Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture serves Stripe’s most complex and consequential users. The team combines deep technical expertise, commercial judgment, and customer empathy to solve problems that often have no established playbook. Its work not only helps individual users grow; it also surfaces emerging needs and opportunities that can inform Stripe’s product strategy and create value for users at global scale. These Solution Architects are deeply embedded in these users and are working along as their technical co-founders.

The Head of Strategic Accounts, Solutions Architecture will lead a team of senior architects who are trusted partners to strategic, key, and major accounts. This leader will set the vision for the team, develop exceptional technical talent, and work closely with account leadership to deepen and grow Stripe’s most important relationships. They will also build a strong partnership with Product and Engineering, turning insights from leading-edge customer engagements into the next wave of innovation across Stripe.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between executive conversations, account strategy, architecture reviews, product discussions, and direct support for the team’s most complex engagements. They will be AI-enabled in how they lead and operate, highly curious about new technologies and business models, and committed to helping their team and Stripe continuously raise the bar.

What You’ll Do

Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, strategy, and operating model for Strategic Accounts Solutions Architecture, aligning the team’s priorities with Stripe’s user, product, and business objectives.
  • Recruit, lead, coach, and retain a world-class team of senior Solutions Architects supporting Stripe’s strategic, key, and major accounts.
  • Partner with account leaders to develop and execute technical account strategies that deepen customer relationships, unlock new use cases, and drive durable growth.
  • Lead from the front in the team’s most complex and high-impact engagements, including architecture workshops, executive briefings, solution design, technical evaluations, and critical escalations.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders at the world’s largest and most innovative companies.
  • Build a close, durable partnership with Stripe Product and Engineering teams; synthesize patterns from strategic accounts, influence product priorities, and help translate customer needs into scalable capabilities for all Stripe users.
  • Create mechanisms for senior architects to share technical insights, reusable patterns, and field learnings across Stripe.
  • Establish a culture of technical excellence, curiosity, accountability, experimentation, and continuous learning.
  • Champion AI-enabled ways of working across the team, using AI to improve insight generation, solution development, team productivity, and the quality and speed of customer outcomes.
  • Develop talent through clear expectations, thoughtful coaching, meaningful feedback, and opportunities for architects to expand their technical, commercial, and leadership impact.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to deliver cohesive outcomes for users.
  • Build processes and metrics that measure the team’s impact on customer outcomes, account growth, product influence, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Anticipate changes in technology, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and industry structure, and translate those signals into action for the team and Stripe.
  • Represent Stripe in executive forums, customer business reviews, industry events, and other strategic engagements.

Minimum Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, or comparable customer-facing architecture teams aligned to strategic, key, or major accounts.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and leading senior technical talent in a complex, high-growth environment.
  • Deep technical fluency and the ability to remain hands-on—quickly understanding architectures, APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security and reliability considerations, and emerging technologies.
  • Experience partnering directly with senior customer executives, product leaders, and engineering leaders on complex, business-critical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated success connecting technical strategy to account growth, customer outcomes, and long-term partnerships.
  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps, shape requirements, and turn customer insights into scalable product innovation.
  • An AI-enabled approach to leadership and problem-solving, with practical experience using AI tools to increase the quality, speed, or scale of work.
  • Exceptional curiosity and learning agility, including a strong desire to explore new technologies, business models, and ways of working.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and business topics clear to audiences at every level.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and make high-quality decisions in fast-moving environments.
  • A collaborative leadership style and a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to engage with strategic customers and collaborate with internal teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with payments, financial infrastructure, fintech space

The Supply Chain Engineering, Principal supports Hut 8’s growing infrastructure portfolio by owning and executing key elements of the procure-to-pay (P2P) lifecycle, delivery assurance, and logistics coordination.

This role ensures that purchase orders are accurately issued, partners close with suppliers to ensure delivery, materials are delivered on time and in compliance with project requirements, and payment processes remain aligned with contractual milestones.

Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Execution & Controls

Process Improvement & Controls

  • Create and improve templates, trackers, dashboards, and logistics reporting tools
  • Identify process bottlenecks in purchasing, delivery, or payment flow
  • Recommend improvements to reduce risk, increase visibility, and improve cash flow timing

  • Demonstrated experience managing purchase orders, expediting suppliers, and coordinating deliveries
  • Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple high-value orders simultaneously

  • Preferred: Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Coupa, Odoo)

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

As Director, US Operations, you will lead operations for Payward’s US equities business: our registered broker-dealer, Kraken Securities LLC, and the operations behind traditional stocks as well as xStocks, our tokenized equities product. You will own the trade operating model, the end-to-end order and settlement flow, cash flows, corporate actions, reconciliations, and regulatory readiness across the business.

This is a hands-on leadership role in a regulated entity. You will be a registered principal of Kraken Securities LLC, named on Form BD, and accountable for the operational side of the firm’s regulatory obligations. It extends well beyond day-to-day management and requires genuine fluency in both traditional market plumbing and the operational realities of a digital-asset business.

You will stay close to company strategy and cross-functional initiatives so the global executive team’s goals translate into clear operating priorities. As a trusted partner, you will work across Compliance, Legal, Finance, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to drive key initiatives forward, and build the team that scales the business as the firm grows.

The opportunity

  • Own the end-to-end order flow for US equities, from inception through clearing and settlement, including reconciliation, corporate actions, and exception management

  • Own xStocks operations: token issuance and redemption, inventory and liquidity management, movement of client and firm assets, and settlement across exchange, custodian, and on-chain venues

  • Serve as a named principal of Kraken Securities LLC and act as an operational control point — including dual-approval (“four eyes”) sign-off on transactions and asset movements, with coverage across time zones

  • Design and implement the operating model for Kraken Securities and xStocks, aligned to strategic goals

  • Build and run the operating systems for the business — policies, written supervisory procedures, controls, books and records, business continuity, and KPIs — and translate C-suite goals into clear targets for each business unit

  • Own launch readiness for new products and markets: prepare systems, policies and procedures, and test them end to end with our clearing firm, custodians, exchange partners and R&D teams to ensure compliance with US regulations

  • Partner with Finance on financial controls around bank payments, customer funds and reserve requirements

  • Ensure desk coverage and settlement/ reconciliation controls and man power in place to support 24X5 and transitioning to 24x7

  • Own vendor and partner operations — clearing, custody, market data, liquidity providers and technology vendors — including onboarding, SLAs and ongoing oversight

  • Own severity-1 operational escalation and incident response for the US entities, including root-cause review and remediation

  • Set performance targets, monitor progress, and report KPIs and costs transparently to leadership

  • Hire and develop a high-performing operations team, build the licensing bench and succession plan, and build the organizational structure to scale

  • Partner with functional leaders across Marketing, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and Operations to keep initiatives aligned and moving

  • Contribute to strategy and growth planning to help build a sustainable business

  • Support functions such as HR and IT in building procedures that link to corporate strategy

What you bring

  • 12+ years of experience in brokerage or fintech operations, and/or at an operations consulting firm, including time inside a FINRA-registered broker-dealer

  • Experience in crypto, brokerage, advisory, fintech, or another highly regulated industry

  • In-depth knowledge of traditional financial markets — execution, clearing, settlement, custody, margin, securities lending, and corporate actions

  • Working understanding of digital assets and tokenized securities, including custody models, on-chain settlement, and the operational controls they demand

  • Direct experience operating under SEC and FINRA rules — books and records, supervisory procedures, trade reporting, and examination response

  • Experience standing up or scaling operations for a new regulated product or entity, including launch readiness and regulatory approval processes

  • A proven record of defining structured approaches to solve complex challenges

  • End-to-end understanding of company value drivers and a strong working understanding of business analytics

  • Experience hiring, managing, and developing operations teams

  • Exceptional judgment and the executive presence to work comfortably with C-suite leaders, regulators, and external partners

  • Required at hire, or within an agreed window from start date: FINRA Series 7 (General Securities Representative), Series 99 (Operations Professional) and Series 24 (General Securities Principal)

  • Preferred: Series 27 or 28 (Financial and Operations Principal)

  • Also valued: Series 57 (Securities Trader) and Series 4 (options principal), or willingness to obtain them — these strengthen our principal coverage across trading and options

  • Must be eligible for registration and disclosure on Form BD, and comfortable carrying named-principal responsibility in a regulated entity

Interviewing with TRM

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

If you want to work on applied AI with real users from day one, this is that job.

 

The Opportunity

  • LLM traffic doesn't behave like normal API traffic. Requests are long-running, streaming and expensive. One prompt can cost a few cents or a few dollars. One team's burst can burn another team's budget. Providers change their rate limits, failure modes and pricing without warning. Running this well is a problem few companies have solved, and it's the job.

    • Own the reliability of the platform engineers depend on: the AI Gateway, the agent runtime and the connections to internal tools. Set the SLOs, own the error budgets and decide what happens when they're spent.

    • Treat capacity and cost as one problem. Routing decisions affect both latency and spend, and you'll own the tradeoff directly.

    • Work with Security, Finance and AI governance to put access controls, budgets, audit logging and data handling into the platform, not into a spreadsheet next to it.

    • Lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews. Turn what breaks into fixes that stay fixed.

    • Automate operations with infrastructure as code, safe deployments and progressive rollouts, so the platform gets more reliable as it grows rather than more fragile.

    • Mentor engineers and raise the operating standard across the team.

Role Impact

You will build continual learning systems that turn agent trajectories, corrections, and failures into new tasks and model updates. Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Role scope

Control update cadence, policy lag, task drift, and exploration, and evaluate each checkpoint on earlier skills, unseen tasks, and general capabilities. Build task-generation and training pipelines with reproducible data and harness versions, so regressions can be traced to a specific change and rolled back. You will work directly with the external collaborators whose deployments drive the research.

  • Select high-value production traces and interventions, convert them into training signal, and establish regression gates before a change reaches deployment.

  • Determine which adaptation belongs in model weights, harness state, memory, tools, or data, then measure the tradeoffs across a sequence of tasks.

  • Build evaluations that distinguish retained learning and transfer from memorization, context accumulation, or measurement drift.

  • Methods for selective consolidation, replay, adaptation, memory, and online or offline RL.

  • Promotion gates and human oversight for agents that continue to change in production.

  • Field experiments, benchmarks, and open research that make continual improvement measurable and transferable.

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

About the Role

Altitude Development Partners is hiring a Risk Analyst for our DeFi hedge fund: someone who deeply understands both decentralized finance and traditional finance mechanics.

The core of the job is to take apart the fund's strategies and positions, work out where and under what conditions we could lose money, and propose concrete, actionable ways to manage and mitigate that risk.

What You Will Do

  • Position breakdown: Dissect each strategy and portfolio position to uncover latent risks, edge cases, and conditions where losses could occur.
  • Correlation & concentration analysis: Assess shared sources of risk across positions, tail-risk events, and market conditions that could impact multiple strategies simultaneously.
  • Scenario stress-testing: Model severe market shocks: violent price dislocations, interest rate spikes, liquidity dry-ups, oracle failures, or heavy withdrawal cascades.
  • Liquidity & exit modeling: Accurately estimate time-to-exit under distress and quantify expected liquidation or slippage losses.
  • Risk parameters & controls: Propose position limits, leverage constraints, real-time monitoring metrics, and programmatic circuit breakers to cut or exit exposure.
  • Clear team communication: Deliver crisp, actionable risk assessments and decisions to portfolio managers and engineers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Grounding in financial mechanics: Clear mastery of yield sources, interest rate curves, cost of capital, leverage, collateralization ratios, and liquidation cascades.
  • Deep understanding of DeFi risk: Protocol insolvency risks, stablecoin depeg mechanics, smart contract vulnerabilities, oracle latency/manipulation, and protocol composability dependencies.
  • Portfolio-level perspective: You evaluate the aggregate risk across the entire book rather than isolating positions in a silo.
  • Data & scenario fluency: You translate theoretical vulnerabilities into concrete probabilities, numbers, and parameters the team can act on.
  • Actionable decision-making: Your deliverables are pragmatic decisions and risk bounds, not merely passive observations.

Location & Work Environment

  • Workplace: Fully Remote (global team).
  • Focus: DeFi Hedge Fund Portfolio Risk Management.

How to Apply

To apply, send an email directly to careers@altitudedp.com with:

  • A brief note explaining why this role fits your background and experience
  • Details or links to relevant risk modeling, financial analysis, or research you have conducted
  • Your CV, resume, or LinkedIn profile
